scope: Two new original videos and one 7.5-second editorial alternative; no final-film approval.
method: Three distinct reviewers independently opened actual extracted images, then cross-reviewed the other two findings. PD inspected contact sheets and selected conservative state-only intervals.
limitations: No reviewer claimed continuous playback, actual audio listening, pronunciation, or lip-sync verification.
Frame sampling does not establish real-time 0.75-second readability or comic timing.
